title: FOLDING TOP REINF, TAPPING & WEAR PLATES, FILLER SUPT & LID PIN SUPT.
summary: Rear deck area behind the seats (body panel rear upper, above the rear wheelhouses): wear plates, reinforcements (LH/RH) and a riveted tapping plate for the folding top on convertibles; on coupes a nut plate riveted to the rear upper panel. The support assembly at the top of the lock pillar (filler / lid pin support, LH/RH) is riveted and cemented to the lock pillar. Joints are sealed with 122g / 52g sealer and bonded with 57e cement and 226a adhesive.
